title: Implement TransactionController for POST /api/v1/transactions
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/transactions accepts { client_uuid, outlet_id, items[], payments[], customer_id? }
Idempotent: same client_uuid returns the same transaction without double insert
Returns 201 with transaction data on success
Returns 409/200 with existing transaction on duplicate client_uuid
completion_summary: TransactionController Store (+TransactionRequest, payments[] multi) 201/200 replay, kasir allowed, 422 insufficient/payment errors; HTTP smoke 4/4
